message.content: {"note_claim": "The video shows US Air Force Globemaster III aircraft airdropping aid over Gaza, not Chinese planes.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "most of the clips circulating online actually show a United States aid airdrop over Beit Lahiya, northern Gaza, from March 2024.", "reason": "The page debunks the Chinese airdrop claim, identifying the aircraft as a US-operated C-17 Globemaster III and the footage as a US aid drop, though it does not address the note's Y-20 wing design or markings details or its 'C-26' label."}

parsed.note_claim: The video shows US Air Force Globemaster III aircraft airdropping aid over Gaza, not Chinese planes.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: most of the clips circulating online actually show a United States aid airdrop over Beit Lahiya, northern Gaza, from March 2024.
parsed.reason: The page debunks the Chinese airdrop claim, identifying the aircraft as a US-operated C-17 Globemaster III and the footage as a US aid drop, though it does not address the note's Y-20 wing design or markings details or its 'C-26' label.
